about: Teams of the VGCPastes Reg M-C survey of 2026-10-02 (227 pastes with EVs stated; MC379 is in the registry already as PP_8025F0AEF5F2D1B6, so 226 are checked here) that do not pass setup under the POOL kind of main at 0.29.0, with every blocker of each (public data API: forme, ability, item, move and Mega lookups and the support gate, in the order of the sets). kinds: move-unsupported, item-unsupported, ability-unsupported and mega (a Mega Stone whose Mega Evolution is not supported) are rows of the tables that no mechanic is marked for; ability-illegal is an ability that the base forme does not have (the paste lists the ability of the Mega forme); move is a move name that no table has. Generated once, by a throw-away program against the library of that version (not committed): a later import checks the same way again. A team that passes is imported into data/teams (never edited) under the id PP_ and the upper case paste id.
